response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB * 1.0 / l.HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per_patient) SELECT pp.ID, pp.SEX, pp.avg_wbc, pp.ratio, pp.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS diff_from_mean FROM per_patient pp CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE pp.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Records with HCT = 0 or NULL give a NULL ratio (SQLite division by zero returns NULL) and are ignored by AVG. HGB is multiplied by 1.0 to force real division.
The overall mean is the unweighted average of the per-patient average ratios, not a record-level average. The request says to take the mean across all patients.
